name: zotero
description: Fork of the Zotero plugin with Zotero Manager for metadata, collections, tags, and linked local PDFs.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Zotero metadata, tags, collections, and PDF links
interface.longDescription: Includes the original Zotero skill and Zotero Manager with locally verified metadata, collection, incremental tag, linked-PDF and relinking workflows. Management writes require user authorization through Zotero 10.
defaultPrompt: @Zotero find papers in my library about transformers and add citations to my draft
@Zotero export my Zotero library to references.bib
@Zotero search my Zotero library and show the BibTeX keys
